description: The address of a car maker's own page of current offers (rebates, special APRs, lease deals), and of a model's page where one can be built, with whether the maker lists national offers at all and when the address was checked. Use it to point someone to the maker's official offers before comparing a rebate with a special APR (rebate_vs_apr). Returns links only, not the offers themselves, which change often and can vary by region.

make.description: The car maker, like Toyota or Ford

model.description: Model, like Corolla Cross, for the model's own offers page where there is one

name: offers_page
title: A maker's official offers page
